storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry cupboard for 6 to 12 months. In Mumbai's monsoon, keep it dry and away from sunlight; a few dried neem leaves or a short stay in the freezer helps against weevils. Cooked dal keeps 2 days in the fridge.
looksLike: Small, flat, half-lentils in a salmon-orange to pink-orange colour. They turn yellow when cooked and fall apart into a soft dal.
howToPick: Look for even, bright salmon-orange split lentils with no black bits, no dust, no insect holes and no musty smell. Pale, dull or mixed colours suggest old stock or a blend of different dals.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months in a sealed pack (check the printed best-before date).

usedIn.raw: 45 g dry split masoor dal per serving (3 heaped tbsp)
